en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a domed religious building with a large metal-clad dome topped by a cross. The façade has an arched entrance, statues, and a prominent cross in the entryway. Ivy covers parts of the walls. In front of the building there are early 20th‑century automobiles parked on the street. The reverse side is a divided back with space for address and message and a small printer's logo composed of the letters "L K" or "L K S" in a box.
